description: Source code for date-related command-line utility functions, including date formatting, parsing, and timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: show_relative_dates
methods.description: Displays dates relative to current time based on input timestamps.

methods.name: show_human_dates
methods.description: Displays human-readable dates for input timestamps.

methods.name: show_dates
methods.description: Displays formatted dates based on a specified format string.

methods.name: parse_dates
methods.description: Parses date strings into timestamps and displays them.

methods.name: parse_approxidate
methods.description: Parses approximate date strings into timestamps.

methods.name: parse_approx_timestamp
methods.description: Parses approximate date strings into timestamps and displays the raw timestamp.

methods.name: getnanos
methods.description: Retrieves current nanotime and optionally subtracts a specified start time.

methods.name: cmd__date
methods.description: Main command handler for date-related subcommands.
